prospective students from singapore can discover more about trinity including contacts and equivalent entry qualifications for undergraduate and postgraduate study below. you can also register your interest to find out more. register your interest international foundation programme entry requirements our international foundation programme is aimed at students who have the drive and ambition to attend a world-class educational institute, but cannot begin an undergraduate degree directly. our international foundation programme is a year-long programme designed to allow students to develop the skills required to succeed and excel in a competitive university environment. to find out more about the trinity international foundation programme, please visit this page . to apply to the international foundation programme, you will need: english requirements: ielts 5.0 with 5.0 in writing with no element below 4.5 duolingo english test: minimum overall score of 80/160 english requirements for law, pharmacy and psychology: ielts 6.0 with no band below 5.5 duolingo english test: minimum overall score of 90/160 academic requirements: gce o levels c grade and above undergraduate requirements trinity is delighted to accept students from singapore who have completed one of the international qualifications recognised by trinity which are detailed below. accepted qualifications for direct applications include: polytechnic diploma - 3.0 minimum gpa gce a levels click here for a quick guide to trinity requirements for gce a levels international baccalaureate click here for a quick guide to trinity requirements for international baccalaureate us high school diploma with sat or act click here for a quick guide to trinity requirements for us high school diploma in addition, to qualify for admission to a degree course at the university you must: meet the minimum matriculation requirements (pass grades in english, mathematics, a language other than english, and a full set of valid subjects for your examination system) display a high level of competence in the english language in one of the examination systems recognised by trinity college dublin. details on accepted english proficiencies are available on our admission requirements page satisfy course specific requirements. some courses will have additional requirements and restrictions for admission. they are detailed on the relevant course page and on our admission requirements page meet competitive standards for admission to the course. please note that posted scores are minimum entrance requirements only and do not guarantee admission. where places are competitive, a student must have excellent examination results to qualify for a place on their preferred course. these standards are indicative only and final assessment will be made by trinity's academic registry. important note on your application applicants from your country will normally be defined by trinity as non-eu applicants; this is based on residency rather than nationality. your eu/non-eu status is an important part of your application and it is your responsibility to determine your correct status before making an application, as the method of application and requirements will differ. determining eu/non-eu status (undergraduate) making an application for detailed information on how to make an application to study at trinity college dublin, please see our how to apply guide. there are many different ways to come to university and trinity encourages applicants from all backgrounds and circumstances to apply. for more information on alternative paths to trinity, such as advanced entry transfers please see our guide to non-standard applications here advanced entry ( singapore polytechnic diploma holders) trinity recognises the singapore polytechnic diploma and student are eligible for direct entry admission where they satisfy the course requirements of their intended programme at trinity and obtain a cgpa of 3.0. advanced entry is possible to certain programmes provided students have obtained a polytechnic diploma in a similar discipline of intended undergraduate study, the year of entry will be determined by the match of subjects and by performance. click on link below for specific advanced entry requirements [applying for a transfer trinity college dublin from another institution] https://www.tcd.ie/study/apply/making-an-application/undergraduate/ postgraduate entry requirements postgraduate work in trinity is academically challenging and the university has high academic entry requirements. applicants will need to: • hold at least a 2.1 honors degree from an irish university or equivalent result from a university in another country. • display a high level of competence in the english language in one of the examination systems recognised by trinity college dublin. details on accepted english proficiencies are available on our admission requirements page some courses may require higher standards or require you to take further tests or attend an interview. more detailed requirements for each course are listed on the relevant course page if you have questions about the specifics of the admission requirements for a given course, or about the course itself, you should contract the course coordinator directly using the contact information available on the courses page. determining eu/non-eu status (postgraduate) fees, funding, scholarships the fees you will be expected to pay to attend trinity college dublin are determined by a number of factors. for more information on how to determine your course fees, and methods of payment, please see our detailed information on fees and finances. undergraduate fees and finances postgraduate fees and finances trinity college dublin offers a number of scholarship opportunities for prospective and current students interested in study or research at ireland's leading university. since its foundation in 1592, trinity college dublin has sought to assist students of limited means and reward academic achievement. students are always encouraged to explore external funding options in their home countries. for more information on scholarship, funding and grant opportunities, please see below. general undergraduate scholarships and funding general postgraduate eligibility see eligibility conditions overview this scholarship supports outstanding students from kazakhstan, kyrgyzstan, tajikistan, turkmenistan, uzbekistan or mongolia to pursue their academic goals at rmit university in melbourne, australia. value and benefits the value of the scholarship is a 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the eligible course(s)* as outlined in your offer letter. eligibility for the scholarship eligibility in order to qualify for this scholarship, you must: be a citizen of kazakhstan, kyrgyzstan, tajikistan, turkmenistan, uzbekistan or mongolia be applying offshore from kazakhstan, kyrgyzstan, tajikistan, turkmenistan, uzbekistan or mongolia be an international student holding a valid student visa or plan to apply for a student visa prior to the course commencement achieve an australian equivalent grade gpa of 2.5 or 70% average or atar 75 in your qualifying qualification at the time of application hold a full or conditional offer letter to commence studies in semester 1 2027 in a: vocational course associate degree* bachelor's degree* graduate certificate graduate diploma masters by coursework degree. not be an existing rmit university student (existing elicos or foundation studies may be qualified and will be notified after foundation studies completion). * exclusions apply to the following degrees: ad023 associate degree in aviation (professional pilots) bp345 bachelor of aviation (pilot training) terms and conditions the scholarship is made available effective from 21 october 2026. the scholarship is available for eligible postgraduate degrees commencing in semester 1 2027 or later. the scholarship is only applicable to tuition fees and non-refundable. scholarship selection is based on academic merit. the scholarship will be revoked if you no longer hold a student visa. the scholarship is only applicable to the eligible course(s) on your initial offer letter. this scholarship cannot be deferred to next intake. successful applicants will be notified. if you do not receive an outcome, your application has not been successful. successful applicants may be invited to participate and get involved in the rmit melbourne open day. the scholarship will be revoked if you are granted any other rmit funded scholarship or australia awards scholarship covering tuition fees. applicants should not be in receipt of any other rmit or australian funded scholarships covering tuition fees including foreign government scholarships. it's important to note that this scholarship has limited availability and will be awarded on a first-come, first-served basis. to secure your scholarship you must accept your offer and make a deposit payment within 14 days from the date of offer letter. for full terms and pages.https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/gradua: privacy notice this site uses cookies to offer you a better browsing experience. by continuing, you are agreeing to the use of cookies on your device as described in our privacy policy . close toggle notification toggle search toggle menu search ntu research scholarship the ntu research scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. eligibility you are eligible for this scholarship if you are a local or international student seeking admission as a full-time candidate pursuing a graduate research programme at ntu. you must have a minimum of honours (distinction) or its equivalent. coverage and award terms there is no bond attached to the scholarship. the award is tenable for one (1) year in the first instance and is renewable subject to good progress. the maximum period of the scholarship is two (2) years for master's candidates and four (4) years for phd candidates, as determined by school as well as availability of research funding in each case. citizenship ​singapore citizen 1 ​singapore permanent resident ​international student 2 revised monthly stipend for students with effect from january 2026. the stipend remains the same for existing students receiving higher stipend rates. phd master's phd master's phd master's monthly stipend s$3800 s$3800 s$3400 s$3000 s$3000 s$2900 1 central provident fund (cpf) contributions shall be provided at a rate pegged to the prevailing employer's contribution rate set by cpf, on top of the monthly stipend received. 2 international students must perform teaching/ laboratory supervision duties to fulfil the requirements of the graduate assistantship programme (gap) . singaporeans and singapore permanent residents may perform gap at the discretion of the schools. for scholars who pass the ph.d. qualifying examination/confirmation, he/she may be eligible for an additional stipend of up to $500 per month. the increased in stipend is subjected to good performance in research and the attainment of required standards for courses taken. the university reserves the right to vary the amount of the stipend at any time by written notice. in addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee. scholarship coverage and award terms are subject to change. the university reserves the right to vary the amount of the award stipend at any time. new students to take note: please update your singapore bank account details in student intranet (gslink) before 15th of the semester commencement month (january or august) to avoid delays in stipend payment. [back to top] application procedure interested candidates should indicate their interest in the scholarship in their application for admission. apply here notification of award successful candidates will be informed on the outcome of their application together with the offer of admissions via email. they are required to observe the terms and conditions for the award of the scholarship.

are 3 scholarships covering all tuition fees for uk-domiciled students from racially minoritised ethnic backgrounds. deadline: 14 september 2026 eligibility to get this equitable scholarship you must: be from a racially minoritised ethnic background (see the uk government's guidance on ethnicity for more details) asian british black black british caribbean or african mixed or multiple ethnic groups have a conditional or unconditional offer to study an eligible full time or 2-year part time msc or mres course be studying in-person at the university of southampton, not through distance learning or a study abroad programme be eligible for home fees be paying your tuition fees yourself not be receiving any external scholarships we cannot accept exchange or partner students. eligible courses full time or part time msc or mres courses from these subject areas are eligible. biological sciences geography and environmental science health sciences ocean and earth science psychology we do not accept students on 2 to 5 year msc courses, pgcert, pgdip, pgr or continuous professional development (cpd) courses. how to apply this is a competitive process and not all applications will be successful. to apply for this scholarship: apply for an eligible postgraduate course at the university of southampton complete and submit the online application form you will need to explain how funding from this scholarship would support your career development in 500 words or fewer. apply now for applications made on or before 5 july, we will contact you: by 31 july if your application is successful after 31 july if your application is not successful for applications made between 5 july and 14 september, we will contact you by the end of september with an outcome. we cannot accept late applications. if your application is successful, you will receive confirmation in writing. all scholarship offers are final, and scholarships cannot be deferred. how we award scholarships there are 4 stages to the shortlisting process: we first check that you meet the eligibility criteria. we then score and rank the supporting statement in your scholarship application. we shortlist candidates, aiming to ensure awards across the breadth of our disciplines. a scholarship panel will make the final selection of 3 scholarship recipients. the decision of the scholarship panel is final. contact us have a question about this scholarship? our friendly scholarships team can support and guide you. admissionspgt.els@southampton.ac.uk we're open monday to friday 9am to 5pm, uk time. useful links find a course terms scholarship supports outstanding students from brunei darussalam, cambodia, indonesia, laos, malaysia, myanmar, philippines, singapore, thailand, timor-leste or vietnam to pursue their academic goals at rmit university in melbourne, australia. in 2025, rmit awarded 4616 scholarships to our international students, including 774 academic merit scholarships. value and benefits the value of the scholarship is a 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the eligible course(s)* as outlined in your offer letter. four reasons to apply for the academic merit scholarship to find out just how much of a difference this financial support can make to an international student's life in australia, we spoke to three recipients about their experience. find out more eligibility for the scholarship eligibility in order to qualify for this scholarship you must: be a citizen of brunei darussalam, cambodia, indonesia, laos, malaysia, myanmar, philippines, singapore, thailand, timor-leste or vietnam be applying offshore from brunei darussalam, cambodia, indonesia, laos, malaysia, myanmar, philippines, singapore, thailand, timor-leste or vietnam (rmit vietnam students who completed cross-campus studies and immediately apply for the same qualification (course) in melbourne campus are not eligible) be an international student holding a valid student visa or plan to apply for a student visa prior to the course commencement achieve australian equivalent grade gpa of 2.5 or 70% average or atar 75 in your qualifying qualification at the time of application hold a full or conditional offer letter to commence studies in vocational education, associate degree*, bachelor's degree*, graduate certificate, graduate diploma or masters by coursework degree not be an existing rmit university student (existing elicos or foundation studies may be qualified and will be notified after foundation studies completion). * exclusions apply to the following degrees: ad023 associate degree in aviation (professional pilots) bp345 bachelor of aviation (pilot training) terms and conditions the scholarship is only applicable to tuition fees. scholarship selection is based on academic merit. the scholarship will be revoked if you no longer hold a student visa. the scholarship is only applicable to the eligible course(s) and duration on your initial offer letter. successful applicants will be notified. if you do not receive an outcome, your application has not been successful. successful applicants may be invited to participate and get involved in the rmit melbourne open day. the scholarship will be revoked if you are granted any other rmit funded scholarship or australia awards scholarship covering tuition fees applicants with foundation studies packaged offer starting from july 2024 may be qualified and will be notified after completing foundation studies. applicants should not be in receipt of any other rmit or australian funded scholarships covering tuition fees (applicants under foreign government scholarships e.g. lpdp, mara are eligible). it's important to note that this scholarship has limited availability and will be awarded on a first-come, first-served basis. to secure your scholarship you must accept your offer and make a deposit payment within 14 days from the date of offer letter. students who are already granted the academic merit scholarship are allowed to change course in future semester, the scholarship will continue apply to a new course as long as a new course is not under the exclusion list above. for full terms and conditions, please view the international scholarships terms and conditions page. how to apply step 1: select an eligible course explore courses for international students. find your course step 2: complete your pages.https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/gradua: privacy notice this site uses cookies to offer you a better browsing experience. by continuing, you are agreeing to the use of cookies on your device as described in our privacy policy . close toggle notification toggle search toggle menu search instep lpdp-ntu master's scholarship the indonesia-ntu singapore talent programme (instep) is a master's scholarship scheme designed for indonesian citizens who wish to pursue a full-time master's degree at nanyang technological university. the scholarship scheme is co- funded by lpdp and ntu. eligibility criteria eligibility criteria indonesian citizens (warga negara indonesia). applicants must be shortlisted by lpdp. applicants must meet the general admission requirements for the master's programme. please refer to the respective programmes for any additional requirements. existing final year undergraduates may apply for admission with a provisional degree certificate and/or yearly examination results to date. for applicants whose native language is not english, the toefl/ielts score is to be submitted with the application for admission (test dates must be within 2 years or less from the date of application). applications without toefl/ielts will still be eligible to apply, but they may be subjected to an interview/test if deemed necessary by the school. application period application period lpdp regular scholarship application period around january/february around june/july ntu master's programmes application period different programmes may have different application deadline dates, please refer to the respective programmes: master's by coursework master's by research (stem) application procedure application procedure applicants must submit their applications to ntu and lpdp separately, along with all required documentation, through the respective application portals: master's by coursework master's by research (stem) lpdp e-beasiswa applicants are required to register an account on both the ntu and lpdp portals, and ensure that all necessary documents are submitted. more information regarding lpdp procedure can be found here . for applicants who are interested in the nie programmes, please refer to the nie graduate programmes application exercise . for nbs programmes, please visit the respective nbs programmed webpages . successful candidates will be shortlisted and selected by lpdp and ntu during the application processes and will be notified of the outcome through the respective channels. lpdp will assess the scholarship eligibility while ntu will assess the academic eligibility. there are 3 main methods of applying for the instep scheme: apply to ntu first à apply to lpdp with a letter of acceptance/offer apply to lpdp first à apply to ntu without a letter of acceptance/offer apply to both ntu and lpdp in parallel (without a letter of acceptance/offer) applicants who have received an offer from ntu but are pending outcome from lpdp or are only applying to lpdp in the next application window are to inform the offering school and/or the office of admissions and/or instep. coverage coverage the maximum duration of scholarship award is one (1) year for master's by coursework and two (2) years for master's by research (stem). the details of the scholarship are as follows: tuition and fees the prevailing tuition fees is available at this url: master's by coursework master's by research (stem) application fees reimbursable monthly stipend in accordance with lpdp's established norms by lpdp for students pursuing a master's degree at ntu for either one (1) or (2) years of study as applicable airfare one (1) round-trip international airfare medical insurance funds to enrol in a medical insurance plan visa-related expenses settling-in allowance, emergency fund, and other expenses according to lpdp and moecrt policies available programmes available programmes there are over 80 programmes available across the 8 colleges at ntu: brochures graduate programme listing graduate programmes (coursework) featured programmes & events graduate programmes (research) featured programmes & events cost of living cost of living estimated monthly expenses campus graduate housing: single en-suite room (aircon) s$ 735 / per resident double en-suite room (aircon) s$ 562 / per resident off-campus shared accommodation s$ 550 – 1900 / per shared household meals s$ 450 – 630 personal expenses s$ 230 – 550 public transport / ride-hailing services s$ 50 – 250 postpaid telecommunication plan (ntu campus is wi-fi enabled) s$ 30 onwards service obligation service obligation after completing ntu master's programme, instep scholarship awardees are expected to return and contribute to indonesia, in accordance with the provisions as set by lpdp. contact contact for more information, please reach out to instepntu@ntu.edu.sg

(dfat) overview rmit university is proud of its longstanding partnership with the australia awards scholarships. funded by the australian department of foreign affairs and trade (dfat), this scholarship aims to promote knowledge, education links and enduring ties between australia and its international neighbours. students from eligible developing countries are given the opportunity to undertake full-time undergraduate or postgraduate study, research and professional development in australia. this experience aims to develop the knowledge and skills of future leaders, who can drive positive change and contribute to development in their own countries. value and benefits the value of the australia awards scholarship varies depending on your country of origin, but the following benefits generally apply: full tuition fees return air travel – payment of a single return, economy class airfare to and from australia, via the most direct route establishment allowance–a once only payment as a contribution towards accommodation expenses, text books, study materials contribution to living expenses (cle) – a fortnightly contribution to basic living expenses paid at a rate determined by the department overseas student health cover (oshc) for the duration of the scholarship pre-course english (pce) fees – if deemed necessary, pce may be available for scholars for in-country and/or in-australia training supplementary academic support may be available to ensure a scholar's academic success or enhance their academic experience fieldwork (for research awards and masters by coursework which have a research component where fieldwork is compulsory) may be available for eligible research scholars for one return economy class airfare via the most direct route to their country of citizenship or within australia please visit the australia awards scholarship website for country-specific details. eligibility for the scholarship eligibility to be eligible for this scholarship you must: be an international student be a citizen of any australia awards scholarship participating country meet the general and country specific eligibility criteria as listed in the australia awards scholarship handbook . support for australia awards scholars your student contact officer (sco) can provide the following information or support for scholars: welcome pack arrival services/ airport pickup temporary accommodation bank account set-up academic support family support travel arrangements return home briefing completion ceremony introductory academic program to support your transition to living and studying in melbourne, we have customised a compulsory introductory academic program (iap) covering: getting to know rmit and melbourne cross-cultural adaptation academic skills. how to apply step 1: check the scholarship dates check on the scholarship application opening and closing dates and participating countries. find application dates step 2: choose your degree from the priority areas of study, choose the rmit degree you would like to study. find your degree step 3: complete your application submit your application to the australia awards scholarships website. submit your application after you apply if you are successful for the scholarship, you will be notified by the australia awards office in your country. the australia awards office will then apply on your behalf so you need not apply directly to us. once you have accepted your scholarship, your student contact officer (sco) will be in touch with you shortly to ensure your transition to rmit is as smooth as possible. meet our scholars "the australia awards mongolian community has been especially supportive. connecting with other scholars and alumni who understand the experience of studying and living abroad has given me encouragement and a strong sense of belonging. this support has helped melbourne feel like a second home while allowing us to remain proud of our mongolian identity." - odgerel munkhbat, master of supply chain and logistics management student "the best part of studying at rmit for me is being part of the city culture and attending ongoing exhibitions, events, and symposiums, where i learn about the industry, design firms, their practices, and current debates. i genuinely appreciate the studio culture in the design hub and working in a shared workspace." - shuvra das, master of landscape architecture student "my studies at rmit, with their practical focus, along with the opportunity to connect with professionals from all over the world, have really broadened my views on leadership and project management. i'm confident that the knowledge i've gained at rmit will help me make a meaningful contribution to my community." - somsouk vangxuexa, master of project management student "during my master's studies, i made many friends and built lasting relationships. these friendships have continued to support me to this day—one friend even helped me secure a job in australia. i am currently a member of parliament in mongolia, working on legislation to introduce a competitive electricity market. after completing my doctoral studies, i joined middleton group in australia. both my academic and professional experiences have been instrumental in my efforts to lead the transition to a competitive and green energy sector in mongolia." provides financial assistance to outstanding students from vietnam. scholarships / scholarships for commencing international students / cobl academic merit scholarships for vietnam value 25% fee reduction eligibility vietnamese students who meet criteria sponsored by rmit university overview this scholarship provides financial assistance to outstanding students from vietnam. value and benefits 25% tuition fee reduction for the eligible program(s) duration outlined on your offer letter. eligibility for the scholarship eligibility in order to qualify for this scholarship you must: be a citizen of vietnam and be applying offshore from vietnam (rmit vietnam students who completed cross-campus studies and immediately apply for the same qualification (program) in melbourne campus are not eligible) be an international student holding a valid student visa or plan to apply for a student visa prior to the program commencemen achieve australian equivalent grade gpa of 3.0 or 75% average in your qualifying qualification at the time of application hold a full or conditional offer letter to commence studies in bachelor's degree, graduate certificate, graduate diploma or masters by coursework programs offered by: school of accounting, information systems and supply chain school of economics, finance and marketing school of management not be an existing rmit university student (existing elicos or foundation studies may be qualified and will be notified after foundation studies completion). terms and conditions the following terms and conditions apply to this scholarship: the scholarship is only applicable for tuition fees. scholarship selection is based on academic merit. the scholarship will be revoked if you no longer hold a student visa. the scholarship is only applicable to the eligible program(s) and duration on your initial offer letter. successful applicants will be notified. if you do not receive an outcome, your application has not been successful. successful applicants may be invited to participate and get involved in the rmit melbourne open day. the scholarship will be revoked if you are granted any other rmit funded scholarship or australia awards scholarship covering tuition fees. applicants with foundation studies packaged offer starting from july 2024 may be qualified and will be notified after completing foundation studies. applicants should not be in receipt of any other rmit funded scholarship or australia awards scholarship covering tuition fees (applicants under foreign government scholarships are eligible). it's important to note that this scholarship has limited availability and will be awarded on a first-come, first-served basis. to secure your scholarship you must accept your offer and make a deposit payment within 14 days from the date of offer letter. students who are already granted the cobl academic merit scholarship are allowed to change program in future semester, the scholarship will continue apply to a new program as long as a new program is offered by the eligible school. for full terms and conditions, please view the international scholarships terms and conditions page. how to apply step 1: choose your course select an eligible course available for international students. find your course step 2: complete your application submit your application to study at rmit. submit your application step 3: accept your offer if you are successful, you will receive an offer letter with the scholarship details outlined. read more explore other scholarships scholarships for tuition fees + additional benefits eligibility colombian students who meet criteria sponsored by rmit and the foundation for the future of colombia (colfuturo) overview the colfuturo-rmit is jointly funded by rmit and the foundation for the future of colombia (colfuturo) and aims to provide further financial assistance to talented colombian students who want to pursue masters and phd programs at rmit. value and duration this scholarship provides: rmit up academic english bursary for latin american students if you are required to study elicos 100% discount on tuition fees for up to 6 eligible students for 3 years of a phd program (with a possible extension to 3.5 years) or 2 years of a masters by research program (with no possibility of extension). 20% reduced tuition fee for master by coursework program in any discipline. colfuturo provides up to a total amount of usd 50000 to cover remaining tuition fees, overseas student health cover (oshc), living costs and other related costs. number of scholarships available scholarships will be distributed evenly across rmit's three colleges: two (2) for stem college two (2) for college of design and social context two (2) for college of business. eligibility for the scholarship eligibility to be eligible for this scholarship you must: be a citizen of colombia have an offer for a masters or phd program at rmit be an awardee of the colfuturo scholarship-loan commence full-time enrolment as an onshore international student. how to apply step 1: check the scholarship dates check on the scholarship application opening and closing dates. find dates on colfuturo's website step 2: apply to rmit submit your application to study a masters by coursework or research degree at rmit. find your course step 3: submit your scholarship application upon receiving an offer from rmit, submit an application for the colfuturo scholarship-loan scheme. apply via colfuturo after you apply selected beneficiaries of the colfuturo scholarship application form as part of your scholarship application you will be required to submit a supporting statement of up to 250 words explaining : why you have selected your chosen course how your chosen course relates to your previous academic or professional experience how your chosen course relates to your future academic or professional goals how your goals will contribute towards creating a more sustainable and inclusive world late applications will not be accepted. how we award there are 5 stages in the shortlisting process. we check that you meet the eligibility criteria. we score and rank the academic qualifications listed on your postgraduate application form. we score and rank the supporting statement included in your application. we shortlist candidates to recognise global talent. a panel chaired by the dean of social sciences, or their nominated representative, decides who receives the scholarships. this is a competitive process, and not all applications will be successful. the scholarship panel's decision is final. we do not provide feedback on applications or decisions. if your application is successful, you will receive a confirmation email and award letter. if you're awarded more than one university of southampton scholarship, you'll automatically receive the highest-value award. help and advice help and advice have a question about this and benefits for 2027 commencement this scholarship provides: a joint tuition fee scholarship from rmit and a top-up living allowance scholarship, china scholarship council (csc) living allowance that includes overseas student health cover (oshc) , one time return international airfare and visa application fees. total stipend amount: au$36963 (2025 research training program stipend rate may vary year on year subject to indexation). eligibility for the scholarship eligibility in order to qualify for this scholarship you must: be a citizen of the people's republic of china have an offer for a phd program at rmit commence full-time enrolment as an onshore international student. how to apply there is a two-stage application process. the closing date for csc applications to rmit is 1 february 2027. stage 1: apply to rmit submit an application to rmit university. only stem programs are currently available to csc applicants. please note that this is a two-stage application process, consisting of an expression of interest (eoi) followed by a full application. we recommend applying early, as processing times typically range from 8 to 12 weeks. indicate that you have applied for, or plan to apply for, a china scholarship council scholarship. how to apply to rmit stage 2: apply to the csc once you have received an offer from rmit university, you will need to apply separately to the csc. you should follow the csc guidelines and apply online for the living allowance scholarship. rmit's offer will need to be included with the csc application. how to apply to the csc stage 1: scholarship you must: be a permanent resident of an eligible country be a self-funded student paying the oversees tuition fees have a conditional or unconditional offer to study an eligible southampton law school postgraduate taught programme exceed your course entry requirements show eligible countries india malaysia how to apply scholarship applications open in october 2026. once applications open, a link to the application form will be available on this page. apply to study an eligible southampton law school programme find a postgraduate taught programme and apply complete the scholarship application form as part of your scholarship application you will be required to submit a supporting statement of up to 250 words explaining : why you have selected your chosen course how your chosen course relates to your previous academic or professional experience how your chosen course relates to your future academic or professional goals how your goals will contribute towards creating a more sustainable and inclusive world late applications will not be accepted. how we award there are 5 stages in the shortlisting process. we check that you meet the eligibility criteria. we score and rank the academic qualifications listed on your postgraduate application form. we shortlist candidates to recognise global talent. we score and rank the supporting statement included in your application. a panel chaired by the dean of social sciences, or their nominated representative, decides who receives the scholarships. this is a competitive process, and not all applications will be successful. the scholarship panel's decision is final. we do not provide feedback on applications or decisions. if your application is successful, you will receive a confirmation email and award letter. if you're awarded more than one university of southampton scholarship, you'll automatically receive the highest-value award. help and advice help and advice have a question about this stream of fast track university pathways program closing date semester 1 2027 intake: 28 january 2027 semester 2 2027 intake: 14 july 2027 how to apply select an eligible program submit an application to study at rmit if you are successful, you will receive an offer letter with the scholarship details outlined. terms and conditions the scholarship is only applicable for tuition fees and is not refundable. the scholarship is only applicable to the eligible program(s) and duration on your initial offer letter. applicants with elicos packaged offer may be eligible. however, they must commence to students applying for the ma holocaust: history, experience, heritage in 2026. the scholarships are offered by the parkes institute for the study of relations between jews and non-jews. they are available to both uk and international students to reduce tuition fees. deadline to apply: tuesday 9 september 2026, midday uk time . eligibility to apply for this scholarship you must: have an offer to study holocaust: history, experience, heritage , either full time or part time achieve a 2:1 (65% minimum) or an equivalent qualification in your undergraduate studies not be getting an external scholarship how to apply this is a competitive process and not all applications will be successful. to apply for this scholarship: write your 500-word personal statement email your personal statement to parkes@soton.ac.uk before the deadline your personal statement should explain: why you want to study at the parkes institute your research interests your professional experience and ambition if relevant, details of financial circumstances the quality of your application and the relevance of your research project to the broad remit of the institute (jewish/non-jewish relations; use of special collections) will be the major consideration when assessing applications. financial need will be considered but will not be a major determining factor in our decision-making. if you want your financial circumstances to be considered, you should provide supporting documentation, such as evidence of incomings and outgoings when you apply. how we award scholarships there are 3 stages to the shortlisting process: we check that you meet the eligibility criteria we review your postgraduate application and scholarship application a selection panel, chaired by the director of the parkes institute, will decide on who gets the scholarships the decision of the scholarship panel is final. help and advice have a question about this scholarship? our friendly scholarships team can support open applications will reopen in 2027 applications close 30 june 2026 value au$2000 one-off payment + other benefits eligibility international students studying at rmit sponsored by medibank overview medibank is the preferred oshc provider for rmit international students. this grant is available to international students which can contribute towards your cost of living. international student health cover requirements value and benefits for 2026 commencement this scholarship provides: the total value of the grant is au$2000, one-off payment to be paid to student's australian bank account after the first census date. industry experience opportunity with medibank. number of scholarships available up to fifteen (15) scholarships are available. eligibility for the scholarship eligibility in order to qualify for this scholarship you must: have a valid offer letter to commence in any vocational education (ve), ass deg, bachelor, or master by coursework program (excluding higher degree by research) in semester 2, 2026 intake. be an international student holding a valid student visa or plan to apply for a student visa prior to the program commencement not be an existing rmit student terms and conditions this scholarship is not refundable successful applicants will be invited for the induction session, where they will be given a guided tour of medibank head office, they will also have the opportunity to attend medibank workshops, participate in event-coordination for medibank on open day, meet recent graduates working at medibank and be involved in a customer focus group. this scholarships is only available to non-existing rmit student. this scholarship is only available for programs listed at international programs and fees rmit international or medibank may profile scholarship recipients. applicants should not be a recipient of any other scholarship covering tuition fees (applicants currently in receipt of a scholarship loan may be considered). successful applicants will be notified; unsuccessful applicants will not be contacted. the scholarships will be offered on a rolling basis until exhausted. for full terms and conditions, please view the international scholarships terms and conditions page. how to apply step 1: choose your course select an eligible ve, associate or bachelor degree, or master by coursework. search courses step 2: apply to rmit submit your application to study at rmit. apply to rmit step 3: complete an expression of interest upon receiving an offer from rmit, submit an expression of interest for the medibank student success grant. submit an expression of interest after you apply selected beneficiaries of the medibank student success grant will then be considered and nominated for the grant. make sure you accept the offer within the deadline. explore other scholarships scholarships for international students explore scholarships and bursaries for international students at rmit. apply to rmit learn how to £3000 off tuition fees for the first year of your postgraduate ma global business ethics and philosophy of management degree. the scholarships are available to uk students and others who pay home fees. deadline: 15 july 2025 eligibility to be eligible for a scholarship you must: have an offer to study ma global business ethics and the philosophy of management exceed your course entry requirements, achieving an average of at least 65 in your undergraduate studies or equivalent qualification be eligible for home fees find out what equivalent qualifications we accept . you must not be getting an external scholarship. how to apply to apply for this scholarship: apply for a ma global business ethics and philosophy of management degree before the deadline you do not need to apply for the scholarship separately. if your application is successful, we will let you know by email. how we award scholarships this is a competitive process and not all applications will be successful. there are 3 stages to the shortlisting process: we check that you meet the eligibility criteria. we review your postgraduate application. a panel, chaired by the head of philosophy, or their nominated representative, will decide on who gets the scholarships. the decision of the scholarship panel is final. contact us have a question about this scholarship? our friendly scholarships team can support
